svg.title: How inference-judge fits together
svg.desc: You write a target file (plug 1). The researcher writes an experiment folder (plug 2). In the loop, the agent, reached through an adapter (plug 4), queues an experiment with a predicted gain, and the driver's runner asks the judge to judge it with one sudo command. The judge runs as another Unix user, behind the wall. It starts the server sealed, sends prompts the server has not seen, counts the tokens itself, checks the answers against a stored reference, launches incumbent and candidate in turn, and writes a verdict the researcher can read. The judge talks to the server being tested over HTTP with the OpenAI API (plug 3).
